preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= k for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each town must produce a type of goods that is between 1 and k.
All integers between 1 and k must occur at least once among the types of goods produced in the towns.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)

The number of roads must match the specified number m.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers, one for each town.
Each number in the output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum travel expenses.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) <= n - 1 for x in stdout.split())
